heading: Smile makeovers in McLean and Alexandria: questions.
items: One design for the whole smile, decided first, then built with whichever treatments it needs: veneers, crowns, bridges, whitening or implants. Most plans use two or three.
Can I preview my new smile?
Yes, free: a Digital Smile Design made from your own photographs and scans, which you approve before a single tooth is prepared.
How is a makeover different from a full-mouth reconstruction?
A makeover works mostly on the teeth that show. A full-mouth reconstruction rebuilds the whole mouth, back teeth and bite included, often with implants.
At both offices, Tysons Corner in McLean and Duke Street in Alexandria, with a laboratory in each building.
How long does a smile makeover take?
It depends on the treatments in the design. Veneers alone can take as few as two appointments once the design is settled; plans with implants take months.
